title: fundamento.config.json
description: Project configuration (Spec 001, D-07). It selects Aspekto packages and nothing else; it is not part of the Modelo. The reference Aspekto is stated only in the Modelo (core.referenceAspekto).

aspektoj.description: Aspekto packages to include besides the reference Aspekto: a path relative to this file, or an npm package name resolved from this file's directory.

markoSpuroj.description: Fingerprint lists of benchmark Aspektoj that check:clean-room reads, as paths relative to this file. Each list holds hashes only and names its own source (Spec 004, FR-15).
